description:
Theoretical formulation parameters for ROMS terrain-following s-coordinates.
Supports Vtransform 1 (Song & Haidvogel 1994) and Vtransform 2 (Shchepetkin & McWilliams 2005).

Cs_r.description: Non-dimensional stretching curves C(s) at RHO points (in [-1.0, 0.0]).
Cs_r.title: Cs R

Cs_w.description: Stretching curves C(s) at W points (in [-1.0, 0.0]).
Cs_w.title: Cs W

Vstretching.description: Vertical stretching function (1: Song/Haidvogel, 2: A. Shchepetkin 2005, 4: UCLA, 5: Souza).
Vstretching.title: Vstretching

Vtransform.description: Vertical transformation equation (1: Song & Haidvogel 1994; 2: Shchepetkin & McWilliams 2005).
Vtransform.title: Vtransform

hc.description: Critical depth / thermocline parameter in meters (hc > 0.0).
hc.title: Hc

s_rho.description: Fractional non-dimensional vertical coordinates at RHO points (in [-1.0, 0.0]).
s_rho.title: S Rho

s_w.description: Fractional vertical coordinates at W points (in [-1.0, 0.0]).
s_w.title: S W

title: ROMSSCoordinateParameters
